title: Learn JavaScript from Scratch
description: Master JavaScript — the language of the web. Build strong fundamentals in JavaScript to power frontend frameworks, dynamic websites, and full-stack development.

Syllabus.title: Introduction to JavaScript
Syllabus.description: Understand what JavaScript is, where it runs, and how it powers the web.
Lesson: Setting up your environment (Browser + VS Code)

Syllabus.title: Variables and Data Types
Syllabus.description: Learn how to store and manage data using variables and primitive types.
Lesson: Data types: number, string, boolean, null, undefined

Syllabus.title: Operators and Expressions
Syllabus.description: Use JavaScript operators to build expressions and evaluate logic.

Syllabus.title: Control Flow
Syllabus.description: Control how your code runs based on conditions and loops.

Syllabus.title: Functions
Syllabus.description: Write reusable blocks of code using functions.

Syllabus.title: Arrays and Looping Through Data
Syllabus.description: Store multiple values and iterate over them.
Lesson: Array methods: push, pop, shift, map, filter

Syllabus.title: Objects and JSON
Syllabus.description: Use objects to group related data and interact with JSON.

Syllabus.title: DOM Manipulation
Syllabus.description: Learn how to interact with web pages dynamically using JavaScript.

Syllabus.title: Events and Forms
Syllabus.description: Handle user actions and manage form input.

Syllabus.title: ES6+ Features
Syllabus.description: Modernize your code with the latest JavaScript features.

Syllabus.title: Asynchronous JavaScript
Syllabus.description: Learn how to work with time-based and network-based operations.

Syllabus.title: Fetching APIs
Syllabus.description: Connect your web app to servers and APIs.
